newsitem.title: UK: MAID/Thorn launch hotel Internet service.
newsitem.headline: MAID/Thorn launch hotel Internet service.

text.p: MAID Plc and Thorn Plc unit, Thorn Business Communications, said on Monday that they have launched a service providing hotels chains across Europe and Africa with in-room Internet services.
They said that the service was launched at the Grosvenor House Hotel in central London and allows users to access the Internet via their in-room television set.
MAID, an on-line information provider said that it expects over 100,000 rooms across Europe and Africa to add the service to their television service over the next six months.
Customers will be charged on a "pay as you view" basis and MAID will receive a percentage of revenues.
